name: Cairnspine Linnorm - Venerable
description: Venerable Cairnspine is a chaotic, instinct-driven worldborn linnorm clever, wingless, non-humanoid linnorm with granite-coloured scales and high slate spines. It seeks to keep mountain slopes stable through controlled rockfalls. At this age it is a legendary, nearly unstoppable presence.

attacks.name: Stonebreaking Jaws
attacks.description: The linnorm strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (4)
abilities.description: The linnorm can be spotlighted up to 4 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Cliff-Grip
abilities.description: The linnorm climbs sheer rock without slowing and cannot be knocked from a cliff by ordinary movement.

abilities.name: Concussive Roar
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 20. On a failure, take 4d8+10 physical damage and the target is knocked back to Close range by gravel and slate. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Spine Sweep
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Make an attack against every enemy within Very Close range. Each success deals 4d8+10 physical damage and the target marks 1 Stress.

abilities.name: Stonewall Stance
abilities.description: When the linnorm takes physical damage while touching rock, mark a Stress to reduce that instance of damage by 2d10.

abilities.name: Bring Down the Mountain
abilities.description: Spend a Fear. Collapse an unstable ceiling, cliff, or slope within Far range. Creatures there make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take 4d8+10 physical damage and become Restrained beneath debris until freed with a successful Strength Roll; on a success, they take half damage and move clear.

abilities.name: Epic Ferocity
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks its fifth HP, it clears 2 Stress and may immediately move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack. If it has fewer than five HP, trigger this after it marks half its total HP instead.
